note: Curated route and access reports. Newest first is not required; the app sorts by date. peak is a peak id or "*" for every peak; route is optional.

items.title: Monitor Ridge snow-free; south-side roads open
items.body: The Mount St. Helens Institute report lists Monitor Ridge from Climbers Bivouac as the preferred route, back to rock and ash, with upper sections possibly snowy or icy. All south-side roads and trailheads are open, including FR 830; there is a significant ledge at the Climbers Bivouac lot entrance.

items.title: South Climb road melted out; little snow below 8,500 ft
items.body: The Forest Service report dated September 20 says the road to the South Climb trailhead is fully accessible with limited parking, and snow is sparse to nonexistent below 8,500 ft. A climbing pass is required above 7,000 ft from May 1 to September 30.
items.source: Gifford Pinchot NF climbing conditions report

items.title: Glacier Creek Road (FS 39) reopened to Heliotrope Ridge
items.body: Washout repairs finished and the road reopened on August 20, restoring vehicle access to the Heliotrope Ridge trailhead for the Coleman–Deming route. Grouse Butte Road (FS 36), a spur off FS 39, was still closed to vehicles.

items.title: Upper Hoh Road listed as open
items.body: Olympic National Park's road conditions page lists the Upper Hoh Road as open. The road has washed out before, so check again before a long drive.
